```lean
intro v
obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.prime v
have h_ne_zero : p ≠ 0 := by rw [Ideal.ne_bot_iff] at hp; exact hp
have h_norm_pos : 0 < Ideal.absNorm p := by apply Ideal.absNorm_pos; exact h_ne_zero
apply lt_trans h_norm_pos
apply Ideal.absNorm_lt_one_iff.mpr
intro r
apply Ideal.mem_of_le_ideal
apply Ideal.le_principal
use r
apply Ideal.absNorm_le_one_iff.mp
apply IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_eq_one_iff_notMem
apply Ideal.not_mem_principal
exact r
```
